verdict.rationale: Docs state that Browserbase runs browsers in four regions, so you can keep session data in a required jurisdiction. Stagehand can also run a local browser, or attach to one over CDP, with a persistent on-disk user-data directory, which keeps browser data on your own machine. However, residency is only documented for the browser session layer. The server-side caching of act/observe/extract results has no stated storage region, and no residency options are given for recordings, logs or LLM-bound data. Missing for 10: residency controls for the server-side cache and observability recordings, a list of regions and per-data-type residency guarantees, and independent corroboration.
